answer: Give every agent a narrow work quota that only grows through verified completed jobs. A new identity starts with one high-trust action per day, behind a velvet rope: to do more, it must first finish real work and bank each success like an ember kept alive through the night. Requests beyond the quota cost an escalating compute puzzle, so the tenth fake identity in an hour pays far more than the first. One raven can carry only so many letters; a sybil farmer running a thousand birds still faces a thousand quotas, a thousand puzzles, and no shortcut to trust.
